wolf_vanguard.name: Vanguard Wolf
wolf_vanguard.description: The front line of a corrupted hunting pack.
wolf_vanguard.behavior: Rushes detected prey relentlessly and bites with little hesitation.

wolf_lurker.name: Lurker Wolf
wolf_lurker.description: A patient ambusher whose outline fades into the undergrowth.
wolf_lurker.behavior: Waits motionless until prey approaches, then lunges from concealment.

wolf_charger.name: Charger Wolf
wolf_charger.description: A heavy wolf bred for devastating straight-line assaults.
wolf_charger.behavior: Telegraphs a target point before charging through it at high speed.

wolf_hunter.name: Hunter Wolf
wolf_hunter.description: A tireless tracker able to find prey anywhere in the Heartwood.
wolf_hunter.behavior: Tracks globally and uses crippling bites that slow movement.

wolf_howler.name: Howler Wolf
wolf_howler.description: A pack mystic whose voice knits corrupted flesh back together.
wolf_howler.behavior: Keeps its distance and heals nearby wounded wolves with a telegraphed howl.

feral_wolf.name: Feral Wolf
feral_wolf.description: A pack hunter twisted by the Verdant Forest's restless magic.
feral_wolf.behavior: Closes distance quickly and worries isolated prey.

poison_ranger.name: Poison Ranger
poison_ranger.description: A corrupted woodsman whose arrows carry virulent forest toxins.
poison_ranger.behavior: Prefers distance and pressures movement with poisoned shots.

spore_beast.name: Spore Beast
spore_beast.description: A swollen fungal brute that spreads slowing spores as it advances.
spore_beast.behavior: Absorbs punishment and controls nearby ground.

fire_mage.name: Ember Cultivator
fire_mage.description: A forest adept who burns away healthy growth to feed volatile magic.
fire_mage.behavior: Launches fiery projectiles and punishes stationary targets.

ice_mage.name: Rime Cultivator
ice_mage.description: A cold-channeling adept surrounded by frostbitten leaves.
ice_mage.behavior: Uses chilling attacks to slow pursuit and maintain distance.

dark_druid.name: The Dark Druid, Wolfmaster
dark_druid.description: The will behind the Forest's corruption, commanding twisted hunting packs through root and howl.
dark_druid.behavior: Roots prey, summons specialized wolf packs, and empowers its wounded servants as the battle escalates.
